title.part2: we all have the power to take action on our salmon consumption.

recommendations.title: Reduce your salmon consumption
recommendations.description:
The first step towards reducing your impact is to gradually reduce your consumption.

Dividing our national consumption by 3 would already significantly reduce the pressure placed on the Ocean, animals and people.

The most effective choice is still to stop eating salmon altogether.

Why? Our food choices have real power: when demand changes, industries adapt. By choosing to stop buying salmon from production methods that cause problems, we send a strong signal to industry and encourage the development of more sustainable alternatives.

recommendations.title: Keep enjoying ocean-inspired flavors (without fish)
recommendations.description: The pleasure of ocean-inspired cuisine does not rely solely on fish. Seaweed, shellfish and new ways of cooking make it possible to rediscover marine flavors while diversifying your diet. Try our fish-free ocean-inspired menus now, with 100% ocean-based and plant-based recipes to delight your taste buds without emptying the Ocean!

recommendations.title: Introduce plant-based alternatives into your diet
recommendations.description: Today, there are many plant-based alternatives that allow you to keep enjoying the recipes you love: plant-based smoked salmon, fillets, spreads and other preparations inspired by seafood products. These alternatives make it possible to rediscover familiar textures, uses and pleasures, while reducing the impact associated with salmon consumption.

recommendations.title: Raise awareness among those around you
recommendations.description: Most people are still unaware of the real impacts associated with salmon consumption. Sharing this information with those around you, starting conversations and introducing other ways of eating are also forms of action. The more of us who understand the issues, the more we can help change practices.

title.part2: if our organizations play their part.

recommendations.title: I suggest 100% plant-based catering for events
recommendations.description:
Meetings, seminars, cocktail receptions, corporate events… all are opportunities to introduce people to another way of enjoying great food.

Generalist or plant-based caterers now offer creative, delicious and inclusive alternatives that more easily accommodate different dietary habits while limiting environmental impact.

recommendations.title: I request support from Seastemik
recommendations.description:
Every company can drive powerful transformations. Seastemik can support you in initiating this change with your relevant teams.

It is urgent, possible (and joyful) to remove fish from food service and move towards an offering aligned with the 10 kg of fish consumed per year per person in France.
